d:
Welcome to Episode 4 of our Madhya Pradesh travel series! In this episode, we explore the historic town of Maheshwar—the ancient capital of the visionary queen Rani Ahilyabai Holkar, situated on the sacred banks of the Narmada River.
Join us as we walk through the grandeur of Ahilya Fort, experience the serene evening boat ride along the Narmada Ghats, explore the centuries-old Maheshwari handloom weaving tradition, and taste authentic local cuisine.
